from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Captures the essential identifying and classification facts of one document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or label of the document as found in the text")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or case type identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
